title: Account Health Actions in Seller Performance Standing: At Risk, Suspension and Deactivation
content:
**Rule.** A good-standing seller is placed at risk when active violation points reach the warning threshold, or when a metric breaches the limits of the seller's current level at evaluation and the metric breach warning setting is true. An at-risk seller returns to good standing at an evaluation where points are below the warning threshold and every metric is within the level's limits. Selling privileges are suspended when active points reach the suspension threshold, when a violation of an immediate-suspension type is recorded, or when any violation is recorded within the probation period counted in calendar days from the reinstatement date. A suspended seller who has not appealed by the end of the appeal window, or whose appeals have reached the per-suspension limit and the last one was rejected, is deactivated.

These account actions are taken by Northloop's systems on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record. When a seller is placed at risk, the record shows the reason — violation points or metric breach; on return to good standing that reason is reset to none. A suspension records the suspension date and places a hold on the seller's payments with the reason "account suspended". A deactivation records the deactivation date.

## Decision table

| Status before | What happens | Status after |
|---|---|---|
| good standing | active violation points reach the warning threshold | at risk |
| good standing | at evaluation a metric breaches the current level's limits, with the metric breach warning setting true | at risk |
| at risk | at an evaluation, points are below the warning threshold **and** every metric is within the level's limits | good standing |
| good standing or at risk | active points reach the suspension threshold | suspended |
| good standing or at risk | a violation of an immediate-suspension type is recorded | suspended |
| good standing or at risk | any violation is recorded within the probation period counted from the reinstatement date | suspended |
| suspended | no appeal by the end of the appeal window | deactivated |
| suspended | appeals have reached the per-suspension limit and the last one was rejected | deactivated |

## The return to good standing, both conditions together

| Points below the warning threshold | Every metric within limits | Returns to good standing at that evaluation |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |
| yes | no | no |
| no | yes | no |
| no | no | no |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An at-risk seller's points have fallen below the warning threshold, but at the evaluation the late shipment rate is above the level's limit. The seller remains at risk.
- A seller reinstated after an appeal has a new violation recorded while still inside the probation period. Selling privileges are suspended, whatever the points total.
- A suspended seller lodges no appeal by the end of the appeal window. The seller is deactivated.
